cd "$(pwd)" && python -c "
from databricks.sdk import WorkspaceClient
w = WorkspaceClient()
wid='4dfab06c923fe3cc'; ws=w.statement_execution
tbl='workspace.mlpabfc8b80.leak_train'
def run(sql):
    r=ws.execute_statement(warehouse_id=wid,statement=sql,wait_timeout='50s')
    return r
cols=['f1','f2','f3','f4','f5','f6']
# per-class mean by feature
sel=', '.join([f'avg(case when label=0 then {c} end) as {c}0, avg(case when label=1 then {c} end) as {c}1' for c in cols])
r=run(f'SELECT {sel} FROM {tbl}')
print('mean(label0)/mean(label1) per feature:')
vals=r.result.data_array[0]
i=0
for c in cols:
    print(f'  {c}: 0->{float(vals[i]):.3f}  1->{float(vals[i+1]):.3f}')
    i+=2
# best-threshold accuracy for f5: count overlap. min of label1 vs max of label0
r=run(f'SELECT min(case when label=1 then f5 end), max(case when label=0 then f5 end), min(case when label=0 then f5 end), max(case when label=1 then f5 end) FROM {tbl}')
print('f5 ranges (min1,max0,min0,max1):', r.result.data_array)
# threshold accuracy at 1.5 for f5
r=run(f'SELECT avg(case when (f5>1.5)=(label=1) then 1.0 else 0.0 end) FROM {tbl}')
print('f5 threshold(1.5) accuracy:', r.result.data_array)
" 2>&1 | head -50
